d: Nepal Prime Minister Balen Shah visits India for his first bilateral foreign trip since assuming office in March, holding talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The two leaders inaugurate a motorable bridge connecting Dharchula in Uttarakhand with Darchula in Nepal and virtually flag off the Saryu-Kamala Express, linking Ayodhya in India with Janakpur in Nepal. Covering approximately 604 km in around 19 hours, the train will operate once a week in each direction from November 28, offering pilgrims a direct connection between the two cities without requiring a train change.
